north_star: Every symbol, equation, value, and line of code in a result has a tool call as its birth certificate; the AI hand-derives nothing.

module_summaries.calculate: Limits, series, sums, inequalities, probability, numerics
module_summaries.codegen: Python function, LaTeX, report, standalone script
module_summaries.derivation: Stateful derivation sessions: compose, step, track, store
module_summaries.formula: Formula search: Wikidata, BioModels, SciPy constants
module_summaries.music: Symbolic tones to waveform, spectrum, WAV
module_summaries.task: Declarative task spec to reification-ladder run/explore (L2/L3)

harness.verifies: ruff lint across src/, tests/, scripts/
ruff format --check (style is enforced, not merely suggested)

harness.command: python -c import nsforge_mcp.server; print('server import ok')

harness.verifies: docs/agent/capabilities.json is in sync with the @mcp.tool set
MCP 2.1.1 discovery, schemas, metadata, payloads, resources, and prompts remain compatible
unseen, randomly-composed formulas derive correctly (a calculus, not a library)
every benchmark derivation carries a complete tool-provenance ledger
the harness guards its own invariants (version, self-description, gate/doc parity)
no whitespace errors or leftover conflict markers
